experiment.rationale: Observed dense-audit Node heap delta exceeded 32 MiB, plus about 5 MiB external memory. 64 MiB is a new experiment allocation, not a measured Workers bound or production default.

measurement.procedure: Fresh Node subprocess for each sample, in-memory SQLite and actual host/repository, five near-256-KiB events. GC before baseline, not during run; samples at SQL boundaries. ASCII, Unicode and dense audit JSON; three repetitions each.
limitations: Node 24 Windows with tsx/SQLite/import and fixture overhead, not Workers or Node 22 acceptance
Baseline includes local SQLite seeded snapshots; startup and producer work are not measured consumer deltas
SQL-boundary observations can miss synchronous/native peaks and exclude real D1/RPC/network serialization
RSS includes heap/native memory. arrayBuffers is part of external; these metrics must not all be added
Column maxima may occur at different moments; heap+external maxima are a conservative observed envelope, not simultaneous total peak
Only ordinary synthetic Images settlement; full BYOK/guardrail/mixed consumers/SSE/error/unknown matrix remains
